title: SFI Research Hub: Prospective Hypothesis and Falsification Registry
description: Governed research compendium for the System Friction Institute. The initial release records prospective hypotheses, counter-hypotheses, falsification criteria, research protocols, reproducible synthetic engineering benchmarks, bilingual working manuscripts, and a candidate System Friction Theory specification. The archive does not claim empirical validation of SFT; it is intended to preserve what was specified before eligible empirical evaluation.
